title: Coupon discount rounded on the gross price
tests: tests/e2e/checkout/coupons.spec.ts::PROJ-101 AC1 applying a valid coupon reduces the cart total
description: With an item discount and a coupon together, the coupon was calculated on the gross price, so the total was too low by a few cents.

title: Sign in times out behind the cookie overlay

description: The cookie consent overlay covered the sign in button on first visit, so the click timed out intermittently.
